confirm_port_change.title: Change port to {new_port}?
confirm_port_change.description:
Changing the port renames the entity IDs of this panel's zone sensors. For example, the entity ID of "{name}" will change from `{old_entity_id}` to `{new_entity_id}`.

Update any automations, scripts or dashboards that use these entity IDs. The entities keep their history. To keep port {old_port}, close this dialog.

no_messages.title: No messages from the alarm system on port {port}
no_messages.description:
Home Assistant hasn't received any message from the alarm system on port {port} for {minutes} minutes, not even a keep-alive.

Check that the alarm system is powered and connected to the network, and that its keep-alive (called Supervision in some versions) is enabled and set to 15 minutes or less. See "Learn more" for where to find it.

This issue is removed automatically when a message is received.
